Looking for Female Roommates (Late May- June 1st Move-In)

Hi! I’m moving to NYC for work from Saint Louis and looking for female roommates (early to mid 20s) to either find a place together or join an existing lease.

Move-in:
Ideally late May cause I graduate May 15 and start work June 1, so I’d love to move a bit early to get settled, explore the city, and ship my things ahead of time.

Location:
Looking for a 30 min or less commute to Grand Central, ideally near the 4/5/6, 7, or E/M lines (open to Murray Hill, Midtown East, LIC, Astoria, Williamsburg, kips  bay, etc.)

Budget:
~$2,200 (flexible if the place is bigger or in a better location)

About me:
I work in tech (software engineering) and will be in-office 5 days a week, so I keep a pretty consistent weekday routine. I currently bartend, tutor and work in research but I enjoy going out and exploring a city in my free time!

I keep shared spaces clean and really enjoy creating a nice homey environment (I’ll be bringing a coffee/wine bar + espresso setup if it fits in my car!). 

Living style:
Looking for roommates who are clean, respectful, and friendly. I’d love a space where we can hang out sometimes (binge shows, wine nights, craft nights, etc.) but also respect personal space.

Totally fine with a social/going-out vibe and having friends over, just prefer things stay respectful on weeknights and not a heavy party apartment. 

I’m 4/20 friendly. I just may not always join depending on work. 

Other:
 • I have a sweet cat (can provide ESA paperwork if needed)
 • Long-distance boyfriend + friends may visit occasionally but will mostly stay in my room or out of the apt
 • Fully new to NYC and excited to explore!

If I sounds like a good fit as roomie or even just a new friend in the NYC area, message me either on FB or instagram: ash_travels_everywhere
